name: Voriconazole
dosing: Weight and route dependent; IV/PO dosing per SmPC
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to voriconazole; concurrent use of contraindicated drugs that prolong QT or have severe interactions (consult SmPC)
interactions: Extensive CYP450 interactions (notably CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP3A4); many drug levels and effects may be altered — check interactions before prescribing
monitoring: Baseline and periodic LFTs; monitor for visual disturbances, skin photosensitivity, and consider therapeutic drug monitoring in prolonged therapy or in patients with significant interactions
pregnancy: Avoid unless potential benefit justifies the risk; seek specialist advice
sideEffects: Visual disturbance (reversible), hepatotoxicity, photosensitivity and skin reactions; may prolong QT interval
clinicalPearls: Important to review drug interactions and consider therapeutic drug monitoring in prolonged therapy; first-line therapy for invasive aspergillosis in many settings
indication: Serious invasive fungal infections such as invasive aspergillosis and certain severe mould/yeast infections
